Iran-US Consultations Held in Qatar on Hormuz Strait and Uranium Transfer

Consultations between Iran and the US took place in Doha, Qatar, focusing on the Strait of Hormuz reopening and uranium transfer. Iranian official Araghchi stated that the outcome of these discussions depends on the US response, and no breakthrough was achieved regarding a two-day plan for reopening the Strait of Hormuz. Gulf leaders also met in Qatar, aiming to prevent further escalation between the US and Iran. The UAE expressed hope for a US-Iran peace breakthrough but remained prepared for negative outcomes. Qatar's prime minister urged Iran to cease attacks on its Gulf neighbors.
